description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to GLES 3.1 Vertex Array Objects, including VertexBinding and VertexAttribute classes, with methods for managing vertex attribute data and bindings.

classes.name: VertexBinding
classes.description: Represents a vertex buffer binding with stride, divisor, offset, and attribute mask.

classes.name: VertexAttribute
classes.description: Represents a vertex attribute with format, pointer, offset, and cache management.

methods.name: VertexBinding::VertexBinding
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with zero bound attribute.

methods.name: VertexBinding::VertexBinding
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a bound attribute.

methods.name: VertexBinding::onContainerBindingChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in container binding, updating buffer state.

methods.name: VertexAttribute::VertexAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing vertex attribute with binding index.

methods.name: VertexAttribute::updateCachedElementLimit
methods.description: Calculates and caches the maximum number of elements based on buffer and binding info.

methods.name: ComputeVertexAttributeStride
methods.description: Computes stride for a vertex attribute based on binding.

methods.name: ComputeVertexAttributeOffset
methods.description: Computes offset for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: ComputeVertexBindingElementCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of elements for instanced rendering.
